core_categories: Pharmacy and Health; Electronics and Tech; Cameras and Photo; Beauty and Cosmetics; Home and General Goods
specialty_focus: London Drugs is a Canadian retail pharmacy chain that blends traditional pharmacy and health care services with consumer electronics, cameras, beauty, and household goods. It specializes in in-depth tech and photo expertise, specialty healthcare services for chronic conditions, and a specialty pharmacy for complex diseases. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
